svg.title: Evidence-guided Field Alerts
svg.desc: A synthetic monitoring workflow separates screening, estimation and reviewed outputs.

text.tspan: A synthetic monitoring workflow separates screening, estimation and reviewed outputs.
Figure: A synthetic monitoring architecture. Observations and quality flags enter screening; screened inputs and contextual
covariates feed risk estimation. Candidate alerts and reviewed decisions remain distinct, and reviewer rationale is
archived. This is an illustrative software example, not an empirical result.
